title: Tax Parameters and Effective Marginal Tax Rates
description: CBO's projections of individual income tax parameters by filing status, effective marginal tax rates on labor and capital income, and tax wedges among types of investment. Extracted from an Excel workbook with 4-5 sheets covering tax brackets, deductions, credits, AMT parameters, EITC, EMTRs, and tax wedges.

notes.units: Varies by variable: dollar amounts, percentages, percentage points, index values, or counts.
notes.calendar_year: All values are on a calendar-year basis.
notes.filing_status_codes: single = Single; mfj = Married Filing Jointly; hoh = Head of Household; mfs = Married Filing Separately.
notes.eitc_child_codes: 0 = no qualifying children; 1 = one child; 2 = two children; 3plus = three or more children.
notes.vintage_variation: Some variables appear only in certain vintages (e.g., personal exemption and PEP thresholds in older vintages; delta EMTR variables in 2026-02 only).
notes.actual_year: The first column is the most recent actual year; remaining columns are projections.

dimensional_approach: Option A: filing status and child count are encoded in the variable name (e.g., tp_bracket_1_single, tp_eitc_max_credit_3plus).

tables.tax_parameters: Sheet 1 — Individual Income Tax Parameters (statutory rates, brackets, deductions, exemptions, AMT, CTC, EITC, economic parameters)
tables.emtr_labor: Sheet 2 — Effective Marginal Tax Rates on Labor Income
tables.emtr_capital: Sheet 3 — Effective Marginal Tax Rates on Capital Income
tables.tax_wedges: Sheet 4 — Differences in Tax Wedges Among Types of Investment
tables.delta_emtr_capital: Sheet 5 — Changes in Effective Marginal Tax Rates on Capital Income (some vintages only)
